sheets.title: Where Environments is — 1280 × 800
sheets.caption: Same steps on both builds: a guest vault, Settings › Capabilities › Environments switched on, two secrets added (Stripe API key, Database URL). Before, switching the capability on drew a block at the foot of Settings › Vaults and nothing in the vault. After, the block is gone and the vault's own key strip has an Environments key.

sheets.title: The Environments sheet — 1280 × 800
sheets.caption: The key opens a sheet at /vault?environments=1. With no environments it offers the three usual ones as one press each; after one, a key is added from the vault by searching its items, marked required for that environment, and given a value that is concealed until shown. The .env.schema is generated from those and holds no value. The base build has no key to press, so its frames are the vault as it was.

sheets.title: A required value that is missing — 1280 × 800
sheets.caption: Closing the sheet with STRIPE_API_KEY required in production and no value there. The notice is raised by a background job of the capability, not by a panel, so it exists with the sheet closed and Settings never opened. It names keys and environments, never a value.
